content.title: Stray Cow Kicks Down 83-Year-Old in Tambaram
content.caption: A 83-year-old senior citizen was injured when a stray cow knocked him down near Tambaram.

slides.heading: Stray Cow Kicks Down 83-Year-Old in Tambaram
slides.text: A 83-year-old senior citizen was injured when a stray cow knocked him down near Tambaram.

slides.heading: Incident Details
slides.text: A 83-year-old senior citizen Loganathan was riding a two-wheeler near Tambaram when a stray cow knocked him down. He suffered a severe head injury.

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: The incident has gone viral on social media, highlighting the dangers of stray animals near residential areas.
